description:
Send a text message to the worker in a conversation you are part of.
Use for: writing to an applicant or a hired worker. Send an idempotencyKey: the same key with the same conversation and text sends once and answers with that message. Without a key, a repeat sends a second message.
Not for: opening chat with an applicant you have not hired (accept_application).
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: send_message({"conversationId":"c4Rt7nWq2ZxL9pKs","content":"Hi Dana, the side door is open from 9."})
Repeat: A repeat may act again on the thing as it stands then. Read it first.
Errors: conversation_closed, hire_required, message_refused, account_restricted, send_in_progress; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

content.description: The text to send, up to 40000 characters. Text only.

conversationId.description: The conversation id, as on the hire or the application.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique string for this call. Repeat it when you retry, so the call runs once.

name: send_message

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

title: Send a message
